slug: 2024-08-07 RDC - government urged to operationalise the Data Protection Authority

facts.fact: On 6 August 2024 the think tank Law & Technologies presented a study saying the Data Protection Authority required by Article 262 of the Digital Code (cited in the article as Loi 20/017) exists on paper but is not yet operational, and called on the government to draft and sign the decree fixing its organisation and functioning.

note: carried from dataprotectionauthority; no document opened
